dossier.audience_name: Shopify/ecommerce store owner replacing fragmented support tools with Crisp's AI chatbot + shared inbox
dossier.orientation: Crisp is a shared inbox for storefront chat and email with an AI Agent that can be trained on your store's content and connected to Shopify order data to answer common pre- and post-purchase questions before handing a conversation to a human.

setup_conditions: Install the Crisp Shopify app, then separately enable the Shopify integration for Hugo in AI Agent settings (R3)
Enable each Shopify tool individually in AI Agent → Automate → Integrations & MCP → Shopify, with required parameters obtainable and identity verification completed when required (R4)
Train the AI Agent on store content via automatic website browsing, PDF import or Knowledge Base articles (E4)
Build or pick an AI Agent workflow and select the channel it triggers from (E5, E3)
Enable the auto-escalation setting and/or describe situational handover rules for escalations (R1)
decision_gaps: Does the WooCommerce integration expose order/customer data to the Hugo AI Agent as the Shopify article documents, or only to the Inbox?
Which plan tier includes the Hugo AI Agent Shopify tools, and what happens once the included automated-conversation allowance is consumed?
defining_need_fit.supported_core_workflow: Automate repetitive pre/post-purchase questions (order status, returns, FAQs) across chat while keeping a single team inbox for escalations
defining_need_fit.caveat: Documented end-to-end only on the Shopify path: Hugo's order-status tools are Shopify-specific and limited to selected enabled tools, while R5 documents WooCommerce data reaching Crisp without stating it is usable by the AI Agent; returns handling is supported only as knowledge-base answering, not as a return action.
defining_need_fit.why: Shopify order-status retrieval (R3, R4), knowledge-trained FAQ answering (E4, E5) and three documented escalation routes into human-dedicated inboxes within the multi-channel shared inbox (R1, R2, E7) together cover the stated task.

first_email_scope.request: Write exactly one email. Introduce our product to a new buyer with one clear next step.
first_email_scope.workflow: On a 14-day full-feature trial, a Shopify merchant can install the Crisp widget and shared inbox, connect the Shopify app, enable Hugo's Get Order Details tool, train the agent on their own site/help content, and have the AI Agent answer order-status and FAQ chats while unresolved ones escalate into the team's human inbox — a concrete documented setup the email can invite them to try as its single next step.
setup_conditions: New account required for the 14-day full-feature trial (E13)
Shopify app installed, then Shopify integration enabled for Hugo separately (R3)
Each Shopify tool enabled individually with identity verification when required (R4)
AI Agent trained on website, PDFs or Knowledge Base articles (E4)
Auto-escalation setting or situational rules configured for handover (R1)
excluded_promises: No claim that 50% of inquiries are automated (E2 is an unattributed vendor figure with no measurement conditions)
No response-time or headcount reduction promise; the 23→18 minute result is one customer's undated outcome

No growth, volume or revenue outcome claim
No superiority over Intercom, Zendesk or Tidio; E24 is one customer's attributed opinion
No claim that WooCommerce order data is available to the AI Agent
No claim that the AI Agent resolves returns or modifies orders beyond the documented, eligibility-limited tools

ranked_relevance.why: Documents the exact connection of Shopify order/customer context into the Crisp inbox and optionally to the AI Agent, which is the audience's stated setup step.
Names the specific tool that retrieves order status, shipping and tracking, which is the repetitive question the buyer wants automated.
Documents three escalation routes from the AI Agent to human agents, the handoff half of the stated need.
States the single shared inbox centralises chat widget, email and other channels, matching the one-team-inbox requirement.
Describes how the agent learns the store's FAQs from site content, PDFs and Knowledge Base articles, the mechanism behind FAQ automation.
Specifies the manual takeover behaviour and its condition that a human must proactively reply to interrupt the agent.
States the agent can be triggered on the web chat widget, the audience's storefront channel.

Documents reviewing agent transcripts and refining invalid answers, the mechanism for correcting bad AI replies.

Mini pricing with ~90 automated conversations gives the lowest documented entry point with AI credits.

problem_fits.caveat: The selected evidence contains no fact addressing Copilot/MagicReply draft quality or Predict accuracy; this is not established by the selected evidence.
problem_fits.why: A complaint about AI reply quality cannot be answered by any licensed fact here, and the ledger offers no counter-evidence on that feature.

problem_fits.caveat: A no-code builder, template library and transcript-refinement loop describe the configuration path but do not prove the bot is easy to configure, and the complaint is single-source and undated.
problem_fits.why: Templates and iterative refinement are the documented mechanisms that reduce configuration effort for the chatbot the merchant found complex.

segment_objections.objection: A merchant on a paid plan reported Crisp's AI gives plain or inaccurate answers, so the AI Agent may answer order-status and FAQ questions badly in front of customers.
segment_objections.answer: Crisp documents that you can read every AI Agent transcript and refine the agent when an answer was invalid, that the agent answers from your own site content, PDFs and Knowledge Base rather than guessing, that order status is read through a specific Shopify tool you enable, and that the agent can auto-escalate when it lacks an answer or the customer asks for a human.

segment_objections.objection: Setting up the chatbot is reportedly complex, and this is a small team without configuration time.
segment_objections.answer: Workflows can be built with the no-code builder or started from a template library, the documented Shopify setup is an app install plus enabling specific tools, and every new account gets 14 days of full feature access to test it before paying.

silences.reason: No selected evidence describes Copilot/MagicReply draft completeness or the Predict option's accuracy, so the quality complaint itself cannot be answered on its own terms.
silences.question: Is there published documentation on what Copilot/MagicReply and Predict produce, their data sources and their known accuracy limits?

evidence.claim: Crisp documents three explicit escalation methods from Hugo to a human agent: automated, situational, and manual.
evidence.verbatim:
There are 3 ways conversations can be escalated from Hugo to a human agent:

- ****Automated escalation**** → By enabling setting allowing Hugo to automatically escalate conversations when he doesn't have the answer or the user requests a human
- ****Situational escalation**** → By describing situations in which Hugo should directly hand over the conversation to agents
- ****Manual escalation**** → By proactively interrupting Hugo and take over a conversation

context.subject: Crisp Hugo AI Agent
context.claim_scope: Documented escalation/handoff mechanisms from AI Agent to human agent
context.conditions: Automated escalation requires enabling the Auto-Escalation setting; situational escalation requires configured routing rules; manual escalation requires an operator replying to interrupt Hugo
context.limitations: Describes routing conversation to human-dedicated inbox, not a guaranteed assignment to a specific human agent

evidence.claim: An operator replying to a Hugo-handled conversation causes Hugo to interrupt itself and route the conversation to human-dedicated inboxes for the operator to continue.
evidence.verbatim: If you reply to a conversation actively being handled by Hugo, he will interrupt himself and route that conversation to your human-dedicated inboxes, where you can directly continue the conversation yourself.

context.subject: Crisp Hugo AI Agent manual escalation
context.claim_scope: Manual handoff mechanism from AI Agent to a human operator
context.conditions: Triggered when an operator replies directly to a conversation Hugo is handling
context.limitations: Requires proactive human interruption; not an automatic AI-initiated handoff

evidence.claim: Crisp's Shopify integration connects store data to Crisp so operators can access customer and order context, and can also expose selected Shopify tools to Hugo AI Agent.
evidence.verbatim:
The [Crisp Shopify integration](https://crisp.chat/en/integrations/shopify/) connects your online store to [Crisp](https://crisp.chat/fr/) so your team can talk with shoppers, access customer and order context, and automate ecommerce support from one shared Inbox.

Once the Shopify app is installed, you can also connect it to Hugo so your AI Agent and support operators can retrieve or update selected Shopify information during customer conversations.

context.subject: Crisp Shopify integration
context.claim_scope: Shopify integration exposing order/customer data to Crisp Inbox and optionally to Hugo AI Agent
context.conditions: Requires installing the Shopify app and then separately enabling the Shopify integration for Hugo in AI Agent settings
context.limitations: AI Agent access is limited to 'selected' Shopify information via specific enabled tools, not full order/customer data by default

evidence.claim: Crisp defines specific Shopify tools Hugo can use, including retrieving order details and customer address, and updating a shipping address.
evidence.verbatim:
| ****Get Order Details**** | Retrieve information about a specific order, including its status, shipping details, and tracking information |
| ****Get Customer Address**** | Retrieve the current default address associated with a Shopify customer |
| ****Update Order Shipping Address**** | Update selected shipping address fields while the order is still eligible for modification |

context.subject: Hugo AI Agent Shopify tools
context.claim_scope: Specific documented Shopify tool capabilities available to Hugo AI Agent
context.conditions: Each tool must be individually enabled in AI Agent → Automate → Integrations & MCP → Shopify, with required parameters obtainable and identity verification completed when required
context.limitations: Only enabled tools are usable; Update Order Shipping Address only works while order remains eligible for modification

evidence.claim: Crisp's WooCommerce integration lets Crisp access customer data, past orders, cart context, and order events depending on the customer session.
evidence.verbatim: When connected, Crisp can access customer data, past orders, cart context, and order events depending on the customer session.
